faq.whatsappMessage: Hi, I have a question about your tours and experiences in Cartagena.

items.respuesta: It depends on the experience, but it almost always includes boat or yacht transport, a guide, dock fees, and lunch. Check the details on each card before booking.

items.pregunta: How do I book and pay?
items.respuesta: You pay an initial percentage to reserve your spot, and we coordinate the rest directly with you on WhatsApp.

items.pregunta: How far in advance should I book?
items.respuesta: Ideally 24 to 48 hours ahead. For private yachts or special dates, we suggest reaching out with more notice.

items.pregunta: Can I cancel or change the date?
items.respuesta: Yes. Message us on WhatsApp ahead of your tour and we'll help you reschedule without any hassle.

items.pregunta: Is it safe to travel on the boats or yachts?
items.respuesta: Absolutely! All our vessels have up-to-date documentation, life jackets, and experienced crew certified by the harbor master's office.

items.pregunta: Can I put together a custom plan or tour?
items.respuesta: Of course! Message us on WhatsApp and we'll build a plan tailored to you, whether it's to the islands or on a private yacht.
